create_causal_1d_pattern: create a causal 1D attention mask for a given sequence length
build_local_2d_pattern: build a local 2D attention pattern with a given distance threshold and p-norm
generate_swin_attention_pattern: generate a Swin Transformer attention pattern with window size and shift size
create_alibi_pattern: create an ALiBi additive bias mask for a given threshold and attention shape
convert_pattern_to_layout: convert a boolean attention mask to a block-sparse layout for a given block size
